o.norm: a bit of a back door in!
checks expected order, and the + indicates that element had a next sibling at time of emission

i.norm: Appends a compact descriptor for {@code el} to {@code seen}. Format per element: {@code tagName[#id][ownText][+];} - {@code #id} present when the element has an "id" attribute - {@code [text]} present when the element has non-empty own text - {@code +} present when the element had a next sibling at emission time - {@code ;} always appended as a separator
XML parser is case-sensitive, so tag names are preserved exactly as written (e.g. DIV stays DIV)
Elements are emitted in document order as each element is closed (children before their parents)
Each entry: tagName[#id][ownText][+]; — the + confirms the element had a next sibling at emission time
